name: cheapbuddy-media
description: Generate CheapBuddy images and MiniMax-H3 videos from Claude Desktop.
long_description: A local MCP server for CheapBuddy image and video generation. The extension keeps the API key in Claude Desktop's secure configuration and exposes model discovery, optional quotes, image generation, video submission, and job status tools.

tools.name: cheapbuddy_list_media_models
tools.description: List image and video models allowed for the account.

tools.name: cheapbuddy_quote_image
tools.description: Read an optional image-generation rate estimate without reserving balance.

tools.name: cheapbuddy_quote_video
tools.description: Read an optional video-generation rate estimate without reserving balance.

tools.name: cheapbuddy_generate_image
tools.description: Generate, edit, or vary an image through the CheapBuddy image API.

tools.name: cheapbuddy_submit_video
tools.description: Submit a non-blocking MiniMax-H3 video task.

tools.name: cheapbuddy_get_media_job
tools.description: Read the status and temporary artifact URL for a media task.

api_key.title: CheapBuddy API key
api_key.description: A CheapBuddy user key with image/video access. It is stored as a sensitive value by the host.

base_url.title: CheapBuddy Relay base URL
base_url.description: Leave the default unless you use a compatible self-hosted Relay.
